Google is expanding its AI ecosystem by acquiring Howie, a Seattle-based startup developing an AI-powered scheduling assistant. The move brings Howie's technology into Google Labs, highlighting Google's ambition to make everyday work smarter through AI. From automating meetings to managing calendars, AI assistants are transforming productivity.
